sketch.name: LimitUtilization
sketch.description: Exposure against limit, one row per counterparty or obligation: a rating chip, a bar with a warning marker, the percent used and an OK / Watch / Breach chip, sorted by percent used.

props.name: title
props.description: The title shown in the header.

props.name: unit
props.description: The unit shown after exposure and limit amounts.

props.name: warnAt
props.description: Share of the limit (0 to 1) at which a row is on Watch; the bar's marker sits here.

props.name: rows
props.description: The counterparties: name, exposure, limit, rating.

props.name: selected
props.description: The name of the selected row; empty for none.
